pack.title: Discord Privacy Pack
pack.subtitle: Select or drop the extracted folder from your Discord privacy pack (not the ZIP file). It should contain a Messages/ folder.
pack.guideTitle: How do I get my Discord Privacy Pack?
pack.guideStep1: Open Discord -> Settings -> Data & Privacy -> click "Request all of my data".
pack.guideStep2: Wait for Discord's email, download the ZIP archive, and extract (unzip) it to a normal folder.
pack.guideStep3: Click the area below or drag and drop the extracted folder into this window.
pack.clickToSelect: Click or drop the extracted folder here
pack.filterSearchPlaceholder: e.g. hello (leave empty to include all)
pack.errorNotFound: Folder "Messages" not found in pack. Make sure you selected the extracted (not ZIP) Discord pack folder.

dm.title: Clear Direct Message
dm.subtitle: Fetch and clear your messages from a specific DM using only your token and the DM link or ID — no privacy pack needed.
dm.guideTitle: How do I find my Token and DM ID?
dm.guideStep1: DM ID: Open the DM in Discord (browser or app), enable Developer Mode in Advanced settings, right-click the DM or user and click "Copy ID" — or simply copy the URL (discord.com/channels/@me/...).
dm.guideStep2: Token: Open Discord in a browser -> press F12 -> Network tab -> send or load any message -> click a request to discord.com -> copy the "Authorization" header.
dm.guideStep3: Never share your token with anyone. Disvoke only sends it directly to Discord's API.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure your account, cleaning safety options, deletion history, and visual theme.
settings.tokenHint: Stored locally on your computer and sent only to discord.com.
settings.tokenGuideTitle: How do I find my Discord token?
settings.tokenGuideStep1: Open Discord in a web browser (or press Ctrl+Shift+I in the desktop app) to open DevTools.
settings.tokenGuideStep2: Go to the Network tab and switch channels or send a message.
settings.tokenGuideStep3: Click any request to discord.com/api, look under Request Headers, and copy the value next to "Authorization".
settings.delayHint: Minimum 1 second. Slower delays are safer and reduce the chance of rate limits.
settings.noTokenAlert: No Discord token configured! Add your token in Settings or Direct DM first.
settings.batchEnabledHint: Splits large deletions into randomized chunks with long human-like breaks in between.
settings.batchHint: Each batch picks a random size between min and max, followed by a random break.
settings.historyHint: Track deleted message IDs in a JSON file so future sessions automatically skip messages already removed. Autosaves every 20 deletions.
settings.historyNoPath: No file selected — history stored in memory only
settings.editEnabledHint: Replaces each message's text before deleting it. Adds one extra request per message.
settings.editCustomHint: Text that replaces each message before deletion (max 2000 characters).
settings.editRandomLenHint: Generates a fresh random alphanumeric string of this length for every message (1–2000).
